title: How much does reviewer confidence matter in ICLR decisions? [D]
summary: My ICLR submission received ratings of 3 / 3 / 2 with confidence 1 / 3 / 3. One weak accept comes from a low-confidence reviewer (Though their review seemed knowledgeable and pinpointed a key issue in the paper.) the other weak accept and the weak reject both have confidence 3. H
reason: Reddit discussion thread asking about ICLR reviewer confidence; it is community commentary, not a paper/preprint, benchmark release, product, business, policy, or OSS announcement, so no active rule covers it.
